purpose: Host-testable GPIO connectivity replay interface contract shared by fpga/src/gpio.nw and stm32mp135_test_board/baremetal/gpio_test.

replay_header_fields.name: controller
replay_header_fields.semantics: Controller that consumes this replay command. It is exactly one of the controller names listed in this contract.

replay_header_fields.name: signal
replay_header_fields.semantics: Stable signal name from connectivity_manifest.json jumpers[].signal. Both sides use this name as the logical jumper identifier.

replay_header_fields.name: vector_index
replay_header_fields.semantics: Zero-based index into connectivity_manifest.json first_pass_test_plan. Commands with the same vector_index form one drive/sample pair.

replay_header_fields.name: command_kind
replay_header_fields.semantics: Minimal replay operation name. Firmware must dispatch only the operation names listed in this contract.

replay_header_fields.name: drive_value
replay_header_fields.semantics: Logic value, 0 or 1, driven by a drive command. For sample_expect commands this repeats the vector's driven value for traceability.

replay_header_fields.name: expected_value
replay_header_fields.semantics: Logic value, 0 or 1, that the sampler must observe for a sample_expect command. For drive commands this repeats the driven value for traceability.

mpu.semantics: MPU-side replay consumer. It drives commands where command_kind is drive and samples commands where command_kind is sample_expect.

fpga.semantics: FPGA-side replay consumer. It drives commands where command_kind is drive and samples commands where command_kind is sample_expect.

operations.name: drive
operations.required_semantics: Configure the named signal for output on this controller and drive drive_value. This contract does not permit hardware toggling in host tests.

operations.name: sample_expect
operations.required_semantics: Configure/read the named signal as an input on this controller and compare the sampled logic value with expected_value.

vector_semantics: For each vector_index, the manifest chooses exactly one driver controller and one sampler controller. The driver consumes a drive command before the sampler consumes the matching sample_expect command. Bidirectional jumpers have separate vector_index pairs for each direction.
signal_semantics: Signal names are stable logical jumper identifiers, not raw package pins. Pin mapping remains outside this replay ABI until the hardware GPIO layer is implemented.
